title: 6th Live-Action Midnight Diner Series Reveals Returning Cast, Staff, October 20 Debut
content:
The staff for the sixth live-action series adaptation of Yarō Abe 's Shinya Shokudō (The Midnight Diner or La Cantine de Minuit ) manga announced on Wednesday the new series' returning cast members, returning and new directors, writers, and October 20 premiere on MBS , TBS and other channels in Japan.

The returning cast members are:

From top rows in image above

• Mansaku Fuwa as Chū-san

• Toshiki Ayata as Kosuzu

• Tamae Ando as Maririn (Marilyn)

• Shōhei Uno as Komichi

• Risa Sudō as Miki

• Asako Kobayashi as Rumi

• Naoko Yoshimoto as Kana

• Kiyofumi Kaneko as Kanemoto

Bottom rows:

• Takashi Yamanaka as Gen

• Yūichirō Nakayama as Hachiro

• Aki Maeda as Noriko

• Yoshimi Nozaki as Tsutae Suzaki

• Ken Mitsuishi as Noguchi

• Kimiko Yo as Chieko

• Yutaka Matsushige as Ryū

• Joe Odagiri as Kogure

Additional returning cast members include:

• Mitsuki Tanimura as Kasumi

• Yukiko Shinohara as Izumi Natsuki

• Kaoru Hirata as Saya Adachi

• Yukihiro Yoshimi as Kō-chan

• Shūhei Takahashi as Kimitoshi

Returning director Jōji Matsuoka will direct the new series' episodes 2, 5, and 8. Nobuhiro Yamashita will direct episodes 7 and 9, and Shōtarō Kobayashi will direct episode 6. New series directors Satoko Yokohama will direct episode 4, and Ryō Yoshida will direct episodes 1, 3, and 10. Katsuhiko Manabe , Kōsuke Mukai, Kensaku Kojima , and Marina Ōshima are writing the scripts.

Kaoru Kobayashi reprise his role as Master.

Netflix began streaming the fifth live-action series in October 2019. Jōji Matsuoka , Nobuhiro Yamashita , and Shōtarō Kobayashi returned from previous series to direct the fifth one. The fourth series began streaming on Netflix under the title Midnight Diner: Tokyo Stories in 2016.

Abe's manga centers on the proprietor of a small, mysterious cafeteria in Shinjuku and his customers. The cafeteria opens at midnight to fix customers any dish they request. The manga was nominated for the bookseller-selected Manga Taishō ("Cartoon Grand Prize") in 2009. The manga was also nominated for Angoulême's Best Comic Award and Audience Award in 2018.

The manga also inspired two live-action films starring Kaoru Kobayashi as Master. A Chinese live-action film adaptation of the manga opened in China in 2019. Well Go USA released the Chinese live-action film on Blu-ray Disc in 2021.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fourteenth Ending Featuring "gr8 story" by SuG
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its foureenth ending, featuring the song “gr8 story” by SuG. The song was used in Episodes 166-177, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the thirteenth ending, featuring the song “Yume no Manual” by CHERRYBLOSSOM . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 New "Cyberpsycho" Sneak Peek Trailer Spotlights Weak Kingsley
content:
CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 has revealed a new sneak peek trailer, putting the spotlight on Weak Kingsley in footage titled “Cyberpsycho.” Studio TRIGGER is back to animate. We recently spoke with the show’s writer and producer Bartosz Sztybor , who told us why they chose the studio and shared insights into the production.

The new anime is a new 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , earlier described as “a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.” It is directed by Kai Ikarashi, who directed Episode 6 of the original anime titled “Girl on Fire.” Ichigo Kanno is the character designer, while screenplay will be handled by Masahiko Otsuka. Bartosz Sztybor is also back as showrunner, story writer, and producer. Netflix will stream the anime, which is set to premiere on October 20, 2026 .

You can watch the English dub version of the new trailer below.

Four of the main characters and their Japanese/English voice cast were previously revealed. They include:

• Weak Kingsley: Once known as “King,” a veteran edgerunner at the top of his game, Weak now lives in the shadow of his former glory.

• D: A Snake Nation netrunner with sharp technical skills and a sharper hunger for revenge, D hunts the killer who wiped out his clan.

• Roman Carax: A young cinephile searching for real stories. In a city that abandoned cinema for neurodance. Obsessed with documenting the truth, he closely follows the lives of other people.

• Talia Yang: Raised in the corpo towers, but hardened by the trials of Maelström, Talia is fiercely independent, steeped in hyperviolent culture, and obsessed with her gang’s chrome.

Also check out the Japanese dub version of the new trailer:

CD PROJEKT RED (or CDPR) is the company behind the Cyberpunk 2077 video game. Studio TRIGGER also animated the first CYBERPUNK: EDGE RUNNERS anime series, which was released in September 2022 and also had a total of 10 episodes. The franchise launched a prequel manga focused on Rebecca and Pilar in December 2024.

The first anime was voted as the Best New Anime of the year in our yearly awards for that year, as well as the Best Original Anime. Netflix is streaming the show , describing its story: The series tells a standalone, 10-episode story about a street kid trying to survive in Night City — a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future. Having everything to lose, he stays alive by becoming an edgerunner — a mercenary outlaw also known as a cyberpunk.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rock Band cinema staff Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content:
The official website of cinema staff announced on Wednesday that the four-member rock band will disband on September 12, 2027, following their final one-man live concert at Toyasu PIT in Tokyo.

According to the statement , the band will conclude their regular activities after an event appearance at LIQUIDROOM on December 17, before holding their farewell performance in September 2027. The decision was made following discussions among the members and staff. Additionally, the band confirmed that their music festival "OOPARTS," which has been hosted annually in their hometown of Gifu since 2013, will end with its 2026 event, canceling the previously planned "OOPARTS 2027."

cinema staff was originally formed in 2003 as a predecessor band by high school classmates Tomotaka Tsuji, Mizuki Iida, and Souhei Mishima in Gifu Prefecture. Drummer Youhei Kuno joined the group in 2006, establishing the current four-member lineup. They made their major debut under Pony Canyon in 2012.

• cinema staff is best known for performing the theme songs for Shingeki no Kyojin , Shingeki no Kyojin Season 3 Part 2 , Shingeki no Kyojin: Kuinaki Sentaku , and Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Arc-V .
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System Episode 13 Preview Revealed
content:
The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System has revealed the preview for Episode 13 ahead of its September 24 premiere. The series is streaming on Crunchyroll and previously confirmed two consecutive cours . Studio GoHands is in charge of the animation.

Episode 13 is titled “Lacoryna, City of Adventurers,” and you can see the synopsis and preview images below: After defeating Malice and saying goodbye to the Edvaughn family, Elymas visits Lacoryna, the holy land of adventurers. He enters a new dungeon hoping to find Blacksteel equipment.

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Chief Director: Shingo Suzuki

• Director: Katsumasa Yokomine

• Character Design: Takayuki Uchida

• Chief Animation Directors: Takayuki Uchida, Keiji Tani, Makoto Furuta

• Chief Director: Tetsuichi Yamagishi

• Main Animator: Hiroshi Okubo

• Sound Production: Glovision Kudan Studio

• Sound Directors: 中島えんじ, Tetsuya Gunji

• Music: Ludvig Forssell

• Animation Production: GoHands

The anime previously revealed a U.S. exclusive visual , which you can see below.

The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System (Tsuiho Sareta Tensei Ju Kishi wa Gemu Chishiki de Muso Suru) is originally a Japanese light novel series by Nekoko, featuring illustrations by Jyaian. It first began on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in April 2021, while Kodansha acquired it and began publishing it in June 2022. The manga adaptation by Lee Brocco began on Kodansha’s YanMaga Web website and app in February 2022, while it was transferred to Weekly Young Magazine in September 2024. The story follows Elma, an MC who knows that the world he lives in is the same as the one of a game he used to play. While others underestimate it, he knows that the Heavy Knight class is the most powerful one, and he uses the memories from his past life to ‘game the system’ and effectively conquer the entire world.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime's New Video Teases Escape from Akasaka
content:
Netflix streamed a new "sneak peek" video, teasing an escape scene from an Arasaka building, from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime on Tuesday.

The staff describe the series:

It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge. When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

The casts include (Japanese/English):

• Momoka Terasawa/Valeria Rodriguez as Roman Carax

• Akari Kitō/Kimoy Lee as Talia Yang

• Kōki Uchiyama/Nazeeh Tarsha as D

• Kentarō Tone/Clancy Brown as Weak Kingsley

Kai Ikarashi (who was a storyboard artist, animation director, animator, and prop designer for the first series) is helming the new series in his directorial debut. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners producer and writer Bartosz Sztybor is again working on the series, and Ichigo Kanno (animation director and key animator on the first series) is the lead character designer. Masahiko Otsuka is returning as the scriptwriter. The new series will stream on Netflix .

The new anime's opening theme song is The Cure 's 1978 song "10:15 Saturday Night," and the ending theme song is Petite Meller 's "Watson." Rapper RICO NASTY wrote and performed "YOU CAN'T RUN FROM ME" for the anime, and it appeared in the second teaser trailer.

The new anime will debut on October 20 on Netflix . The first episode had a premiere screening at Anime Expo on July 3.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , the anime series by Studio Trigger based on CD PROJEKT RED 's Cyberpunk 2077 game, debuted on Netflix in September 2022. The game is itself based on Mike Pondsmith 's Cyberpunk tabletop RPG game series.

Aniplex of America will release the series on a complete Blu-ray Disc set in North America on October 28. Anime Limited and Plaion Pictures will release the series on home video in Europe, and Sugoi Co will release the series on home video in Australia and New Zealand.

A prequel manga titled Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness from artist Asano ( BNA: Brand New Animal manga) and writer Bartosz Sztybor ( CD PROJEKT RED ) launched on the Comic Alive+ website in December 2024, and is getting a release in seven languages aside from Japanese. Dark Horse is releasing the series in English in print.

Update: Arasaka's spelling corrected. Thanks, FilthyCasual.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and it’s going to be another exciting quarter for fans. The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is one of the most anticipated series of the year. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Hyūganatsu , the story centers around Maomao, a genius apothecary with a knack for solving mysteries. With more than 57 million copies of the light novel and manga volumes in circulation, The Apothecary Diaries is easily one of the most popular franchises in the world. The popularity skyrocketed across the globe after the successful anime adaptation in October 2023. The second season was a major turning point in the anime, and the lives of Maomao and those around her will continue to change.

The rebellion of the Shi Clan was a massive failure, but it forced Jinshi to reveal his true identity. The story has yet to explore more about him and his relationship with the royal family. Now that September is heading towards its end, the Fall 2026 anime series are all preparing for their debut. The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is one such series that fans are looking forward to the most, since it’s going to be the most crucial season of the anime.

3) The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Will Premiere on Crunchyroll

Although the streaming time hasn’t been revealed by the platform, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 will premiere on Crunchyroll . The platform has been streaming the anime since its debut, so it was more or less guaranteed that the anime’s sequel would premiere weekly episodes on Crunchyroll as well. You can also catch up with the previous seasons on the platform, which is streaming all the episodes. The official seasonal lineup also confirmed that the anime will release the English dub as well.

Details on the dubbed episodes will only be shared after the premiere. However, since Crunchyroll usually takes two weeks for dubbed episodes, we can expect the same schedule for The Apothecary Diaries as well. Not only that, but the anime will be streaming on Netflix in select regions of Asia. It usually takes Netflix a few months or even years to add certain in it’s U.S. library, which means Crunchyroll is the only platform fans will be able to watch the anime.

2) The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Will Take a Major Turning Point

As mentioned earlier, Jinshi has already revealed his identity as the Moon Prince, which means he can’t work as an Eunuch anymore. He has also taken on his royal duties since he is still the Crown Prince, as the Emperor’s younger brother. However, he won’t be able to hold on to the title for much longer now that Concubine Gyokuyou has given birth to a prince. Her status will also rise after her second child is born, so it wouldn’t be surprising if the Rear Palace goes through another massive change.

Not only that, but Maomao has stopped working at the Palace, and she has returned to the Verdigris House. Instead of working as a courtesan, she resumes her duties as the apothecary, which is obviously more suited for her. Jinshi often visits her despite his busy schedule, but it’s nowhere near the same as the two of them living in the palace. However, the duo will go on another trip in Season 3 as Jinshi asked for her assistance in solving the mystery behind the strange events in the Northern farming villages.

1) The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Changed Its Schedule

This is the first time the anime will take a hiatus between its cours . The two seasons released both their cours consecutively, but Season 3 will only release its first part in the Fall 2026 season. The second cour will be released in April next year as part of the Spring 2027 anime lineup. While the episode count hasn’t been revealed yet, we can expect at least 12-13 episodes for each cour.

Additionally, each cour will adapt one volume of the light novel, so the upcoming season will cover Volumes 5 and 6. While there’s no official confirmation yet, it’s evident that the schedule is to help the animation studio maintain the quality without overexerting the animators more than necessary. Due to the tight deadlines and the anime’s increasing popularity, it’s understandable that the studio is under a lot of pressure to maintain the quality of the animation. The anime keeps surprising fans with new visuals in every season, and there’s no denying that Season 3 will be even better.

However, he won’t be able to hold on to the title for much longer now that Concubine Gyokuyou has given birth to a prince. Her status will also rise after her second child is born, so it wouldn’t be surprising if the Rear Palace goes through another massive change.

Not only that, but Maomao has stopped working at the Palace, and she has returned to the Verdigris House. Instead of working as a courtesan, she resumes her duties as the apothecary, which is obviously more suited for her. Jinshi often visits her despite his busy schedule, but it’s nowhere near the same as the two of them living in the palace. However, the duo will go on another trip in Season 3 as Jinshi asked for her assistance in solving the mystery behind the strange events in the Northern farming villages.
1) The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Changed Its Schedule

This is the first time the anime will take a hiatus between its cours . The two seasons released both their cours consecutively, but Season 3 will only release its first part in the Fall 2026 season. The second cour will be released in April next year as part of the Spring 2027 anime lineup. While the episode count hasn’t been revealed yet, we can expect at least 12-13 episodes for each cour.

Additionally, each cour will adapt one volume of the light novel, so the upcoming season will cover Volumes 5 and 6. While there’s no official confirmation yet, it’s evident that the schedule is to help the animation studio maintain the quality without overexerting the animators more than necessary. Due to the tight deadlines and the anime’s increasing popularity, it’s understandable that the studio is under a lot of pressure to maintain the quality of the animation. The anime keeps surprising fans with new visuals in every season, and there’s no denying that Season 3 will be even better.

title: 3 Years Ago, One of the Greatest Shonen Fantasies Premiered & It Still Stands Above the Rest
content:
It’s been three years since the debut of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End , and it’s still one of the greatest Shonen of all time. Shonen fantasies have always been a cornerstone in Japanese storytelling, easily making their way into the anime and manga industry. Not only that, but the fantasy setting also allows room for a captivating storyline while exploring unique worldbuilding and complex power systems. Such series take fans on epic journeys, blending classic adventure themes with modern animation and complex narratives. A lot of the critically acclaimed anime series these days have fantasy elements blended into them , but not all fully embrace the magical charm of the genre.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is one of the few series that actually does it well, which is why it’s one of the most highly rated anime of all time. The anime premiered on September 29th, 2023, and it shook the anime industry thanks to its unique premise and exceptional storytelling. The anime dethroned Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood on MyAnimeList charts, and it continues to attract more viewers. When it comes to Shonen fantasies or just any genre, there’s no denying that Frieren will always be listed among some of the best shows of all time.

Nostalgia Is the Most Definitive Strength of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End

A major reason behind the series’ success is how it beautifully weaves present-day events with echoes of the past, creating a narrative where both timelines exist side-by-side. The story begins with the end of a 10-year-long journey where Himmel the Hero and his party brought peace to the continent by defeating the Demon King. One of the party members is Frieren, an elven mage with a much longer lifespan compared to everyone else around her.

This is why the 10-year-long journey was merely a fraction of her lifetime she spent with her party. It wasn’t supposed to mean much to her, but by the time she realized that the journey changed her life significantly , it was too late. Himmel died of old age, and Frieren regretted never knowing more about him. This is the starting point of the story as she learns about a place called Aureole where the souls of the dead rest.

She begins a new journey to meet Himmel and make up for the regret she has. Instead of unfolding the story in a straight line, the anime focuses on reflective glimpses into Frieren’s journey with Himmel’s party. It not only adds emotional depth to the story but also affects her present decision, which again highlights how her previous journey changed her in so many ways. This beautiful narrative allows the viewers to feel the passage of time in a quiet yet nostalgic journey. This pattern continues in both seasons of the anime as she travels all across the continent and revisits the places while keeping the memory of Himmel the Hero alive.

Frieren: Beyond Journey ‘s End Is All Set for Its Return Next Year

The anime released its second season this year, and the story is far from over. Season 3 will by far be the most exciting part of the story since it will adapt the Golden Land Arc, the best arc of the manga. While the third season doesn’t have an exact release date yet, it will premiere in October next year as part of the Fall 2027 anime lineup. The second season was only 10 episodes long, but at least it ended after setting up the premise of the arc. As the name suggests, the story will take place in the Golden Land, a city that has been turned to gold by a mysterious power.

Following the defeat of Revolte in Season 2, Frieren’s party parted ways with Methode and Genau and continued their travels. They learn about a certain land rumored to be turned into gold, which has already sparked the interest of nearby towns and villages. The second season’s finale revealed that not only is the Golden City real, but it’s also Denken’s homeland, where one of the Seven Sages of Destruction is resting.

Mahat will formally be introduced in the upcoming season , and the previous ties with him and Frieren will also be explained. He is one of the most powerful and intriguing characters in the entire series. Not to mention that he is the first Sage of Destruction the anime has introduced, which will help fans understand the true extent of the power these demons possess.

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime's New Video Teases Escape from Akasaka
content:
Netflix streamed a new "sneak peek" video, teasing an escape scene from an Akasaka building, from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime on Tuesday.

The staff describe the series:

It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge. When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

The casts include (Japanese/English):

• Momoka Terasawa/Valeria Rodriguez as Roman Carax

• Akari Kitō/Kimoy Lee as Talia Yang

• Kōki Uchiyama/Nazeeh Tarsha as D

• Kentarō Tone/Clancy Brown as Weak Kingsley

Kai Ikarashi (who was a storyboard artist, animation director, animator, and prop designer for the first series) is helming the new series in his directorial debut. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners producer and writer Bartosz Sztybor is again working on the series, and Ichigo Kanno (animation director and key animator on the first series) is the lead character designer. Masahiko Otsuka is returning as the scriptwriter. The new series will stream on Netflix .

The new anime's opening theme song is The Cure 's 1978 song "10:15 Saturday Night," and the ending theme song is Petite Meller 's "Watson." Rapper RICO NASTY wrote and performed "YOU CAN'T RUN FROM ME" for the anime, and it appeared in the second teaser trailer.

The new anime will debut on October 20 on Netflix . The first episode had a premiere screening at Anime Expo on July 3.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , the anime series by Studio Trigger based on CD PROJEKT RED 's Cyberpunk 2077 game, debuted on Netflix in September 2022. The game is itself based on Mike Pondsmith 's Cyberpunk tabletop RPG game series.

Aniplex of America will release the series on a complete Blu-ray Disc set in North America on October 28. Anime Limited and Plaion Pictures will release the series on home video in Europe, and Sugoi Co will release the series on home video in Australia and New Zealand.

A prequel manga titled Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness from artist Asano ( BNA: Brand New Animal manga) and writer Bartosz Sztybor ( CD PROJEKT RED ) launched on the Comic Alive+ website in December 2024, and is getting a release in seven languages aside from Japanese. Dark Horse is releasing the series in English in print.

title: Fire Force Studio Returns With New Crunchyroll Anime This Fall – Watch Trailer
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and some of the biggest highlights of the lineup are the sequel seasons of Black Clover and The Apothecary Diaries . It’s the final quarter of the year and probably the biggest one yet thanks to the major series returning with new seasons. However, the Fall 2026 season is just as crucial for new debuts as well. Just like every other season, Crunchyroll will be streaming dozens of new series for fans across the globe. It’s the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the globe, which is all the more reason why it includes most of the seasonal releases.

The Fall 2026 lineup of the platform has just been released, and it confirms both the subbed and dubbed titles. This also includes Firefly Wedding , one of the most anticipated releases of the year. It’s the first major anime from David Production after the Fire Force finale in April this year. The animation studio has been around since 2007, and since then it has worked on several critically acclaimed series including JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, Undead Unluck, and more. The latest project from the studio is a historical romance that is all set for its Crunchyroll debut next month .

Firefly Wedding Will Be Streaming on Crunchyroll

Along with an official confirmation on its website, Crunchyroll also revealed that the anime will release its English dub soon. The subbed episode will premiere on October 9th, 2026. The anime will be available across North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, and the Indian Subcontinent.

While the streaming time hasn’t been revealed yet, we can expect the episodes to drop around a couple of hours after the Japanese broadcast. The full schedule should be released around the time of the premiere. Additionally, it usually takes Crunchyroll at least two weeks before streaming English dub episodes, and details will only be revealed shortly after the premiere.

Firefly Wedding is one of the most anticipated anime of the year thanks to the exceptional story and gorgeous animation. Around the same time as Crunchyroll’s confirmation, the anime also released a new PV that introduces a majority of the characters while highlighting the premise of the story.

What Is Firefly Wedding About?

The anime is based on an acclaimed manga written and illustrated by Oreco Tachibana. The manga began serialization in Shogakukan’s MangaONE magazine in January 2023 and reached its conclusion three years later. The story takes place in the Meiji Era, following Satoko, the eldest daughter of the noble Kirigaya family, who has to turn down many marriage proposals from men who covet her beauty. Although she has a heart condition and doesn’t have long to live, she wants to find a suitable husband to ease her father’s worries.

Her life takes a drastic turn when she is kidnapped by Shinpei Goto, a legendary assassin. In order to save herself, she asks him to marry her under the pretense of love at first sight. However, what begins as a desperate attempt to save herself soon turns into a dangerous obsession for the assassin. While the story ended earlier this year, the ending also sparked massive fan backlash, and it’s still one of the most hated finales in recent years.
